[non-codebase] evidence for AC-3 (Gerrit Verified result — inherently external to the repo):

Gerrit change 2480 ("chore: tie 29a6 to landed fix") is MERGED. Its submitted revision is
6e3ecc060664 — the exact commit that (a) carries `rebar-ticket: ddc2-66ae-a863-4e09` and
`rebar-ticket: 29a6-bbb7-0114-400a`, and (b) moves
tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py::test_legacy_payloads_without_material_still_round_trip
onto pytest `tmp_path` (tracker = tmp_path/"tracker"), eliminating the `.rebar-test-sidecar-material`
repo-root scratch dir.

Gerrit Verified label on 2480: approved (+1) by "rebar CI bot". A merged change on this project
requires `Verified +1` AND `LLM-Review +1` as a submit precondition, so the merge itself attests
the Verified gate passed on the revision containing the tmp_path fix. The earlier ticket note about
"Gerrit HTTPS/SSH timing out" was a transient host condition at that moment; the change has since
merged (verified via Gerrit REST: status=MERGED, current_revision=6e3ecc060664).

The prior verifier finding read a pinned snapshot from before this evidence was recorded; re-verifying now.
